icon_encoding.centre: The unique centre is the middle of a solid 5x5 effect-colour core.
icon_encoding.effect_core: Chebyshev distance 0..2 from the centre uses an effect RGB exactly.
icon_encoding.window_frame: Chebyshev distance 4 uses a window RGB exactly.

effect_legend.rule: The edge cannot be entered while its incident window is active; wait until the window end.
Entering during the active window adds 17 seconds; waiting until the window end is allowed.
Entering during the active window adds 29 seconds; waiting until the window end is allowed.

metadata.edge_matching_rule: Transform each icon centre to world coordinates and match it to LineString vertex properties.atlas_anchor_vertex. The match is exact apart from decimal serialization.

routing.time_units: integer seconds on one shared clock
routing.incident_window_semantics: Half-open [start_seconds,end_seconds): active at start, inactive at end.
routing.incident_entry_semantics: Effects depend on edge-entry time. For CLOSED, wait to end. For a delay, choose the earlier of entering now with the delay or waiting to end and entering without it. Waiting at nodes is allowed.
routing.arrival_semantics: arrival_seconds is the absolute shared-clock time at the destination.
routing.checkpoint_semantics: The ordered route must visit the mandatory checkpoint at least once.
